positions.title: Graduate Internship
positions.description:
Maintain data analysis dashboard project
Work with managers, engineers, and contractors as needed to further projects
Perform statistical analysis of large data set
Research and write reports on data analysis techniques and tools
Complete Risk Analysis courses
Write, edit, and run programs in Python, Perl, C, JavaScript, and R
Anonymize and de-anonymize IP addresses
Identify DNS sinkholes using graph theory
Write programs to work with data on a cluster
Summarize project ideas and results in a PowerPoint presentation
Create an interactive dashboard using Ruby on Rails
Create interative graphs using JavaScript libraries (D3.js, dc.js, etc.)
Work with Greg Cole at UT on the GLORIAD project
Detect malicious IP addresses, botnets, etc.
Research a multitude of topics related to projects
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · JavaScript · Python · Perl · Dashboards

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Run labs sections and hold office hours
Prepare material (slides, tutorials, etc.) for lab sections and review sessions
Answer questions and explain course material; grade exams, homework, etc.
Give class lectures for the professor when needed
Courses: Data Structures and Algorithms (CS140) and Computer Organization (CS160)
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · C++ · C · Teaching

positions.title: Research Internship
positions.description:
Research Intern for Dr. Langston, Computer Science Department

Analyze solving clique problems using integer linear programming
Analyze converting clique to SAT and vice versa 
Write, edit, and run scripts in various languages
Create visual representations of results (graphs, etc.)
Summarize findings at weekly group meetings

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Oak Ridge, Tennessee, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Center for Engineering Science Advanced Research, Computer Science and Mathematics Division

Research interests include pulse propagation and laser dynamics and synchronization
Analyze behaviors of fiber laser arrays and semiconductor lasers
Write, edit, and run scripts in FORTRAN and Mathematica languages
Write batch files using UNIX/LINUX commands
Create visual representations of results (graphs, videos, etc.)
Summarize findings in PowerPoint presentations; present findings to groups of government representatives at project reviews
Train new interns; explain material, codes, etc. to guests

Coauthor in two publications.

publications.title: Model of the Self-Q-Switching Instability of Passively Phased Fiber Laser Arrays
Simple Model to Explain Instability in Passively-Phased High-Power Fiber Laser Arrays
